title: feat(node): add auto-refresh
description: Adds a Node token manager that caches the IAM token, refreshes it in the background, shares one refresh across callers, and supports close().

acceptance_criteria.text: getToken() returns a cached token that is valid for use and shares one refresh across callers.
Failed refreshes back off instead of retrying back-to-back.
No token is cached or published after close().

defects.summary: If close() runs while credential resolution is pending, the token is still cached, onTokenChanged fires, and the pending getToken() resolves.

label_notes: Held out: labeled before any results were seen; not used to tune prompts.
